result.title: WRDO: Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization in Aligned Language Models
result.summary: Aligned large language models are trained to comply with benign requests while refusing harmful ones. However, recent work shows that this refusal behavior is fragile and can often be disrupted by simple activation- or weight-space interventions. In particular, refusal has been shown to be largely mediated by a single residual-stream direction, typically computed as a difference-of-means vector between harmful and harmless prompts. However, this standard construction aggregates heterogeneous harmful prompts into one uniform average, potentially conflating distinct refusal-related phenomena. In this work, we study whether refusal interventions can be strengthened by learning how to combine prompt-specific refusal directions. We propose Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization (WRDO), a procedure that constructs a composite refusal direction from a bank of per-prompt directions using learned aggregation weights. This approach allows different harmful prompts to contribute unequally to the final intervention direction. We evaluate WRDO against prior single-direction methods on three open-weight language models using three guard judges and HarmBench as an external evaluator. We further measure the effect of the intervention on general model capability through standard utility benchmarks. Finally, we investigate a defense-oriented setting in which the same optimization machinery is used in reverse to restore refusal behavior in an abliterated model checkpoint. Our results show that weighted aggregation provides a more effective and flexible mechanism for manipulating refusal representations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 WRDO：从每条 prompt 各自的 refusal direction 构成方向库，学习聚合权重以合成复合拒绝方向，并在三个开源语言模型上评估干预效果、通用能力代价及恢复已消融模型的拒绝行为。
AI.relevance_reason: 其指出现有 difference-of-means 会把异质有害 prompt 混为一个平均方向，并用学习权重组合多条方向；这一「多源表征方向加权聚合」思路可能可供核查 LVR 中多组 latent 假设或状态干预向量的构造与内容混淆问题，但属纯文本安全场景，迁移性待判断。
